I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves hygiene control and patient handling to ensure patient safety.

Early pregnancy often begins with subtle changes that are easy to overlook or misinterpret. Many women notice unusual fatigue, nausea, breast tenderness, frequent urination, or a missed period but may not immediately connect these changes to pregnancy.

Recognizing these signs early can reduce confusion and help you seek timely medical guidance. A proper evaluation during this stage helps monitor maternal health from the beginning and provides reassurance about what is normal and what may need attention.

If you are noticing possible early signs of pregnancy and would like medical guidance, an early consultation can help clarify what your body is experiencing and guide you on the next steps. Pregnancy care and early pregnancy evaluation are available at our clinic in Ghatkopar West, Mumbai, under the guidance of Dr. Prabhjot Manchanda, Obstetrician and Gynecologist.

Early medical guidance can help you move forward with clarity, confidence, and appropriate care during the first phase of pregnancy.

This may be a long review, I hope it’s worth reading. 2 normal deliveries and 7 years of experience.

We want to share the secret behind our stress-free medical journey—and that is Dr. Prabhjot Manchanda.

We approached her back in 2019 with our first pregnancy. She guided us perfectly, and we were blessed with a normal delivery. The first pregnancy was full of doubts and confusions, She replied to all our queries with smile. But honestly, her role didn’t end there.

We wanted a proper gap between our children. We were confused about the best way to go about it, but Ma’am sat us down and counseled us. She suggested the Copper T method and cleared all our myths about it.

For the last six years, she hasn't just been our "pregnancy doctor," she has been our family guide. Because of her planning and advice, we had a stress-free gap, and when we were finally ready again in 2026, everything went smoothly.

And guess what? Second baby, 2026—another normal delivery!

That is her specialty. She is so kind and such a good listener. You never feel like a "patient" with a file number; you feel like a person she genuinely cares about. She clears every doubt before you even leave the room. She gives you confidence when you are nervous and calm when you are stressed.

She doesn’t just deliver babies; she delivers peace of mind.

If you are looking for a doctor who supports natural birth and guides you through every stage of life, Dr. Prabhjot Manchanda is the one.

Thank you, Doctor!

Exceptional Care & Trustworthy Expertise—A Deeply Appreciated Recovery Experience of Rohit Vinerkar

My recent admission to Zynova Shalby Hospital for Typhoid Fever (Nov 13-17) reaffirmed the trust my family and I place in this institution, particularly after my mother’s successful knee replacement in 2022.

I approached Dr. Satvik Patel for a second opinion on November 12th. I was thoroughly impressed with his approach; he carefully assessed my situation and ordered the necessary tests. The following day, with the diagnosis confirmed, Dr. Patel advised an SOS admission.

Dr. Patel's Professional Excellence and New Discoveries -
During my treatment for typhoid, another concern related to my health came forward. Dr. Patel immediately took charge, providing guidance and treatment in a cool and composed manner. He is truly the MS Dhoni of medicine, maintaining his calm demeanor and delivering effective treatment under pressure. This ability to manage complex situations without stress was immensely reassuring.
Furthermore, his thoroughness brought to light a fascinating personal detail: I apparently have an abundance of RBCs in my blood. Dr. Patel, not only provided treatment for the fever but also gave me some great life advice—I've been kindly recommended to donate blood often. (It seems I now generate content both for the screen and for the blood bank. Who knew my body was producing a surplus!)
His ability to explain all these complex findings clearly in excellent Marathi instantly built a strong and enduring connection. It was incredibly reassuring to hear detailed medical advice given with such clarity and ease. "तुमचा स्वभाव आणि समजावण्याची पद्धत, सर, अगदी कौतुकास्पद आहे."
We are now hoping to resolve this new challenge soon under his expert care.

Staff, Facilities, and Comfort -
The medical attention and human touch provided by the staff were consistently excellent. The nurses were attentive and meticulous in my care.
Even while recovering in Room 605 (a choice made for the Vastu and morning sunlight), I felt well-supported and comfortable. The colour choice of the interior is lively, and the view from the window is amazing, contributing greatly to the positive atmosphere. I even watched the India vs. South Africa cricket test!

On November 14th, the staff's care gave me enough comfort to watch the broadcast of Doraemon Movie Earth Symphony on Disney India. As I was the Assistant Dubbing Director and Mixing Engineer for that project, it was a unique and meaningful experience to connect with my work while recovering. The quality and timing of the food service were also good.

A Critical Point for Management Consideration -
While the patient care is truly awesome, I must address a severe pain point that impacts accessibility for many patients: The security deposit requested during the admission process is significantly higher than usual.
It is challenging for patients, especially those with high-premium insurance coverage, to submit such a substantial deposit. If Zynova Shalby’s core mission is to serve humanity, I strongly urge the management to reassess this security deposit policy. Streamlining this financial aspect would remove a severe point of friction and ensure that exceptional medical care is accessible to all.

Overall: I am grateful for the expert medical treatment and compassionate attention I received. Thank you, Zynova, and especially Dr. Patel, for taking excellent care of me. "हम दिल से आपके आभारी हैं। एक मरीज को और क्या चाहिए? सब कुछ बहुत अच्छा था।" I am focusing on a swift recovery and look forward to being fit soon!

Did you know your family history could hold important clues about your breast and ovarian cancer risk? 

BRCA is a gene that helps repair damaged cells and maintain normal cell growth. Changes (mutations) in BRCA genes can increase the risk of developing breast and ovarian cancers, making early risk assessment important. 

Who should consider a BRCA assessment? 
• Individuals with a family history of breast, ovarian, or related cancers 
• Breast cancer patients, especially those diagnosed at a younger age 
• Ovarian cancer patients 
• Individuals with multiple family members affected by cancer 
• Anyone concerned about inherited cancer risk 

You may benefit from a genetic consultation if: 
• You are a breast cancer survivor and BRCA positive and want to understand the risk for your children or siblings. 
• A close family member had BRCA-positive breast or ovarian cancer. 
• Your grandmother or parent was BRCA positive and you wish to know when to get assessed. 
• Multiple women in your family have had breast or ovarian cancer. 
• Cancer runs in your family, even if you have no symptoms. 
• You were diagnosed with breast cancer at a younger age. 
• You have already undergone genetic testing and would like expert guidance on your results. 
If any of these situations apply to you, visit your nearest M|O|C Cancer Care for a FREE Genetic Consultation with our expert oncologists from 27th May 2026 to 15th June 2026.

featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)
